utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Hey Grandpa, how's your day going?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh dear, I think you meant 'brake' instead of 'break'. It's important to use the right words, especially when driving.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Oh, thanks for pointing that out! I'll be more careful with my words.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: You're welcome, dear. Always happy to help you learn.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I really appreciate your help.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Be careful and make sure you're not speeding, dear.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I will, Grandma. Thanks for the reminder!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I trust you, dear, but I just want to make sure you're safe. It's my job to worry a little.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I know, Grandma. I promise I'll be careful. Love you!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Alright, dear, I understand. Just keep focusing on the road and drive safely.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I will, Grandma. Thanks for always looking out for me.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Because I care about you and want to make sure you're safe, dear.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I know, and I appreciate it. I'll call you once I get there safely.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I see! Well, I'm glad you're keeping things light-hearted.
